title: Nonnegativity of the intersection tail
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $0\le\delta\le1$, let $U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $k\in\mathbb{N}$. The weighted sum of the indicators that a random subset's intersection with $U$ has size at least $k$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $U$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
